notes:
Product: VS Code-focused copilot (internal name: CodeWeave).
Primary ask: streaming inline suggestions and low-latency completions inside editor with per-developer quotas.
Key quotes: "Users expect inline suggestion appear <60ms for local typing flows"; "need model pinning and deterministic rollout between model versions".
Current arch: extension => proxy service (Node) => vendor LLM. Prototype uses SSE for streams; devs want WebSocket fallback for flaky mobile hotspots.
Security: enterprise customers require SSO (SAML), audit logs, and optional VPC/private control plane for big accounts. Legal asking for 7y retention matrix + deletion workflow.
Cost sensitivity: high for public tier (target ARR & unit economics), will consider Dedicated for >100k monthly tokens.
Technical notes: prefer models with KV-cache support, quantized variants for lower cost, need server-side token accounting per VS Code user.
Previous activity: ran small hosted trial on OpenAI; seeing jitter and rate-limit errors when >120 concurrent devs. Looking for predictable tail latency and deterministic fallbacks.
SE input: Riley ran latency bench (internal) — 90th p90 ~240ms for current provider; target <=120ms.
Decision markers: SSO + rate-limit SLA + streaming quality acceptable = procurement.
